newsitem.title: USA: Fund inflows slow in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: Fund inflows slow in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash inflows of U.S. mutual funds slowed to $365 million in the three-day period ended October 24, compared with $839 million for the two-day period ended October 21, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracker said that U.S. stock funds recorded inflows of $325 million versus $549 million in the previous. Bond funds also posted slower inflows, $40 million versus $242 million.

Aggressive funds had inflows of $352 million versus $102 million for the previous period. Growth and income funds had inflows of $378 million versus $220 million. International funds had outflows of $550 million versus inflows of $290 million.
On the bond side, government/GNMA funds had outflows of $130 million versus outflows of $26 million and muni funds posted inflows of $65 million versus $231 million.
Trim Tabs tracks data from 903 funds, with total equity fund assets of $470 billion and bond fund assets of $247 billion.
